lawyer:
Khan Saifur Rahman with Ehasanul Hoque Quiyum with Md Abu Hanif, Advocates—For the Appellants. 
AKM Nazrul Islam, Advocate-For the Informant 
Nikhilesh Dutta, Deputy Attorney-General with Md Rabiul Karim, Assistant Attorney-General with Md Jamil Akhter Elahi, Assistant Attorney-General-For the Opposite Party-State.
parties:
Nagor Ali Munshi and others ----- Appellants
Vs.
State ----- Respondent
full_judgment:
Khademul Islam Chowdhury J: This appeal is directed against Judgment and order dated 5-11-2000 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge Narsingdi, in Sessions Case No. 9 of 1997 convicting the appellant Nos. 1-6 under sections 302/34 PC and sentencing each of them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for life and to pay a fine of Taka 10,000 (ten thousand) in default to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 3(three) years more, convicting appellant Nos. 7 and 9 under section 326, PC and sentencing each of them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 5(five) years and to pay fine of Taka 3000 (three thousand) each in default to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 1(one) year more and convict appellant No. 10 under section 324 Penal Code and sentencing him to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 3(three) years and to pay a fine of Taka 2000 (two thousand) in default to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 6(six) months more. Accused (1) Fazlu Miah, (2) Hiron Mia and (3) Abdul Hye were found not guilty of the charge and were acquitted. 

 2. The prosecution case, in short, is that Md Idris Ali, father of deceased Ruhul Amin as informant, lodged First Information Report at Raipura Police Station on 27-5-1996 at about 13-30 PM alleging, inter alia, that at about 8-00 O'clock in the morning of 27-5-96 on Monday the informant accompanied by his sons Ruhul Amin and Shahidullah were going to their own residence at village Vete Morjal. At about 8-30 AM when they reached at the eastern side of the homestead of one Fazlu Miah of Vete Morjal in Raipura Thana within District Narsingdi due to previous enmity and grudge, with common intention, the accused namely (1) Nagor Ali Munshi, son of late Charag Ali Munshi, (2) Mujibur Rahman (3) Habibur Rahman, (4) Zakir Hossain, (5) Abdur Rahman (6) Mukul, sons of Nagar Ali Munshi, (7) Mamtazuddin Member, son of late Tamizuddin (8) Nurul Islam, son of late Tamizuddin, (9) Abdul Hossain (10) Amjad Hossain, son of Mamtazuddin Member, (11) A Hye , (12) Fazlul, sons of late Suruj Ali, (13) Hiran Miah, son of A Aziz and (14) Shamsuddin, son of Ansar Ali, all of Village Vete Morjal, PS Raipura, District-Narsingdi, armed with deadly weapons namely, dao, dagger, ballam, kirich, etc obstructed them on their way and cordoned them. Accused Mamtazuddin ordered other accused to catch and kill them. Then the informant and his aforesaid two sons tried to escape towards north but accused Nos. 1 Mujibur Rahman 2. Abdul Rahman, 3. Zakir Hossain 4 Abul Hossain caught hold of victim Ruhul Amin and accused Habibur Rahman dealt a blow with dagger on the right side of chest of the victim causing grievous bleeding wound for which he fell down on the earth then accused Nagar Ali Munshi dealt another blow by a kirsch causing grievous injury on the left back side of the chest of the victim. Accused Abdul Hye and Fazlul Miah caught hold of the informant and accused Hiran Miah and Shamsuddin caught hold of another son of the informant Shahidullah. On hue and cry of the informant and his son Shahidullah the daughters of the informant Renuka Begum and Sanjida Sultana came to the place of occurrence and tried to save the victim. But accused Amjad Hossain dealt a dao blow on the person of Renuka by which her right thumb was cut through. Then accused Nurul Islam also hit Renuka Begum with Kirich which caused grievous hurt on her right breast, accused Mukul hit with a dao on Renuka Begum which caused grievous injury to the left elbow joint causing deep bone cut injury, Accused Shamsuddin hit the informant with dagger resulting in injury on cheek. The further case of the prosecution was that victim Ruhul Amin died on the spot as a result of injuries caused by the accused persons. The local witnesses arrived on the spot and had seen the occurrence. The informant after receiving treatment went to Raipura Thana to lodge the FIR and on his oral statement Raipura PS Case No. 19 dated 27-5-96 under sections 341/114/302/326/324/34, Penal Code was started. 

 6. The defence case so far as it can be gathered from the trend of cross examination is that of innocence and their fortifier case is that they were not involved with the alleged-occurrence of murder but they were falsely implicated, that victim died in their house as a result of free fight with people at the house of father-in-law of the deceased whereby informant and others were wounded. On 17-8-2004 the appeal was fixed for hearing. The hearing of the appeal commenced on 8-8-2006 in presence of the learned Advocate for the appellant and it was heard in part. Subsequently, no one appeared to press the appeal on behalf of the appellants. When the appeal was taken up for hearing the learned Assistant Attorney-General appearing for the State was allowed to place the FIR (Exhibit-1), inquest report (Exhibit 2), seizure list (Exhibit-3), post mortem examination report (Exhibit-11), Sketch map and index (Exhibits 11 and 13), depositions of PWs 1-14, and the impugned Judgment. 

 11. PW No. 2 named Md Shahidullah narrated that the informant is his father and the victim Ruhul Amin was his elder brother. On 27-5-96 at morning he along with his father Idris Ali and elder brother Ruhul Amin were coming to their residence from Morjal Somata Bazar and at 8-30 AM when they reached near the house of Fazlu Mia, at east south corner of the land of Fatikemesa Bibi due to previous enmity, with a view to killing the victim, the accuseds 1. Nagor Ali, 2. Mujibur 3. Habibur, 4. Abdur Rahman 5. Zakir 6. Mukul Mia, 7. Momtaz 8. Nurul Islam 9. Abul Hossain 10% Amjad Hossain 11. Abdul Hai, 12. Fazlu Mia, 13. Shamsuddin 14. Hiron Mia armed with deadly weapons namely, dao, kirich and ballam came out from the nearest bamboo clump and obstructed their way and cordoned them. Then the accused Member ordered to other accuseds to catch and kill the victim. Then they ran towards the north side to flee away but the accuseds 1. Mujibur 2. Abdur Rahman 3. Zakir and 4. Abul Hossain caught hold of victim Ruhul Amin. The accuseds Shamsuddin and Hiron caught hold of him and accused Abdul Hai and Fazlu caught hold of informant Idris Ali, Ruhul Amin tried to rescue himself and in course of scuffle ganji on wear of the victim was torn. Then the accused Habibur Rahman inflicted blow with dagger at the right chest of Ruhul Amin causing fatal bleeding wound and he fell down on earth and then and there the accused Nagar Ali Munshi hit second blow with kirich on back of the left chest causing grievous bleeding wound. On hue and cry some local people named Fazlu (PW 8), Tara Mia (PW 3), Anwar Hossain PW 5) and two sisters of this witness named Renuka Begum and Sanjida Sultana reached at the place of occurrence and Renuka Begum tried to save Ruhul Amin but then and there the accused Amjad Hosain dealt a Dao blow which cut down her right thumb. Then the accused Nurul Islam hit Renuka Begum with a kirich causing grievous hurt on the right breast and she fell down on the earth. Then the accused Mukul inflicted blow with ramdao on Renuka Begum cutting the elbow of her left hand including bone. At one time his father Idris Ali, escaped from the hands of the accuseds Abdul Hai and Fazlu and tried to save Ruhul Amin and Renuka Begum but then accused Shamsuddin hit him which caused injury on his left cheek. Victim Ruhul Amin died on the spot. When some other local people came to the spot, all the accuseds left from the place of occurrence. This witness further stated that two days before this occurrence in darbar (meeting) held at the house of one Mahindra Chowkider in presence of accused Nagor Ali, Munshi, present informant and many other people. Nagor Ali Munshi sitting threatened Idris Ali to beat him with shoe to which Ruhul Amin raised objection and then a quarrel took place there. Then Nagar Ali Munshi threatened Ruhul Amin to give him lesson within a day or two. To take revenge subsequently the accused’s killed Ruhul Amin. He was thoroughly cross-examined by the defence lawyer but he narrated the facts of the prosecution case as stated in examination in-chief. Defence suggestion that the instant case is false and he deposed falsely was denied. 

 12. PW 3 Tara Mia is a local witness examined and cross-examined in the case. He testified that he knows both the parties. He further stated that the occurrence took place about 3 years ago at 8-30 in the morning that on hue and cry, he went to the place of occurrence from his own residence and found that the accused’s cordoned the victim Ruhul Amin, Idris Ali and Shahidullah, then Momtaz member ordered other accused’s to catch and kill them. The victim Ruhul Amin, Shahidullah and Idris Ali tried to flee away but on chase the accused’s Abdur Rahman, Mujibur Rahman, Abul Hossain and Zakir caught held the victim Ruhul Amin and the accused Habibur Rahman dealt a dagger blow on the person of victim Ruhul Amin. Then the accused Nagor Ali Munshi hit the victim Ruhul Amin with kirich. The accused Shamsuddin and Hiron caught hold Shahidullah. In the meantime Nasima. Renuka and Anwar Hossain came to the spot. Renuka Begum tried to save her brother Ruhul Amin but accused Amjad Hossain inflicted blow with dao which cut her right thumb. Accused Nurul Islam also hit Renuka Begum with a kirich causing grievous injury on her person. Then the accused Mukul dealt a dao blow to Renuka Begum which cut the elbow of her left hand up to bone. Accused Shamsu hit Idris Ali with dagger which caused simple injury on his left cheek. Ruhul Amin died on the spot. In cross he narrated the facts of the case as stated above. Defence suggestion that the accused did not hit and injure Renuka Begum but he deposed falsely, that he knows nothing about the alleged occurrence but he deposed falsely due to their own groupings and lastly, he was suggested that this occurrence was held at the residence of Idris Ali and Kamal Hossain was the accused who was absconding were denied. 

 13. PW 4 Md Sohrawardi, the son of the informant Md Idris Ali in his deposition stated that on 27-5-96 in the morning he went to village Dhukudir Char and there from at 10-00 AM he got information that his brother victim Ruhul Amin was beaten by accused’s Nagar Ali Munshi, Momtaz Member and their sons. He rushed to the spot and on his arrival at the land of Fatikernessa Bibi under the village Vete Morjal found the dead body of his brother Ruhul Amin lying on the earth. Later on he went to Raipur Police Station along with his father Idris Ali and his father lodged FIR. The Daroga visited the spot and lunge and ganji being wearing apparels of accused victim and blood-stained earth were seized and his signature was obtained, inquest report over the dead body of the victim was prepared in his presence and his signature was obtained, he identified his signature marked Exhibits 3/2, 3/3, found grievous hurt on the right side of the chest of the victim and left side of his back. The accused admitting their presence in the place of occurrence tried to file false case against them (the informant and witnesses) but on enquiry in the court of Magistrate it was proved false. Petition of complaint against the informant and witnesses by way of naraji petition brought by the accused against the enquiry report was rejected up to the Appellate Division. He identified the seized alamats produced before the Court. In cross, he stated the same facts of the case disclosed in examination-in-chief The defence suggestion that the occurrence as stated in the FIR took place at the house of the informant and the pre-sent case has been lodged against the accused’s falsely were denied. 

 14. PW 5 Md Anwar Hossain who deposed as PW No. 5 in his testimony stated that the informant Idris Ali is his maternal grandfather. On 27-5-96 at 8-30 AM he heard hue and cry and rushed to the land of Fatikernessa and found that the accused Abdul Hai and Fazul caught hold the informant Idris Ali and the accuseds Hiron and Shamsuddin caught hold of Shahidullah, accused Mojibur Rahman, Abdur Rahman, Zakir Hossain and Abul Hossain caught hold of victim Ruhul Amin, then accused Habibur Rahman hit Ruhul Amin, with a dagger which caused grievous bleeding wound on the right chest and he fell down on earth Then the accused Nagor Ali Munshi with kirsch inflicted blow on the back side of the left chest of the victim causing grievous bleeding wound. At that moment accused Renuka Begum and Sanjida came and tried to save Ruhul Amin but the accused Amjad Hossain dealt a dao blow on the person of Renuka Begum causing bleeding injury on her right thumb cutting it into two halves. Then the accused Nurul Islam also hit Renuka Begum by a kirich causing grievous wound on her right breast. Accused Mukul also inflicted a dao blow to Renuka Begum which caused grievous injury and cut the elbow of the right hand up to bone. Accused Momtaz Member carrying ballam in hand and ordered all other accused’s to kill whosoever came to the place. The accused Shamsuddin also hit the informant Idris Ali with a dagger which caused injury on his left cheek. The victim died on the spot. Then local people came to the place of occurrence and all the accuseds fled away. In cross by the defence, he stated the facts of the case as disclosed at the time of his examination in-chief. The defence suggestion that he did not see the alleged occurrence, that the occurrence was held at the residence of Idris Ali and he deposed falsely as tutored by the informant, that the informant and his daughter Renuka Begum were not injured by the present accused’s were denied. 

 17. PW No. 8 named Md Fazlu Mia stated in his testimony that the occurrence took place three years ago at 8-30 AM and then he was at his own residence at village Vete Morjal. Suddenly he heard hue and cry and ran towards the spot and found that the informant Idris Ali and his sons Ruhul Amin and Shahid were cordoned by the 14 accused named 1. Nagor Ali Munshi 2. Mojibur Rahman 3. Habibur Rahman 4. Abdur Rahman 5. Zakir 6. Mukul 7. Momtaz member 8. Abul Hossain 9. Nurul Islam 10. Amjad 11. Hiron Mia, 12. Shamsuddin 13. Abdul Hai and 14. Fazlu Mia. Then the accused Momtaz member ordered to catch and kill them. At this accuseds Fazlu and Abdul Hai caught hold the informant Idris Ali and the accuseds Majibur Rahman, Abul Hossain, Abdur Rahman and Zakir Hossain caught hold of victim Ruhul Amin and accused Hiron and Shamsuddin caught hold of Shahid Mia and as Ruhul Amin tried to save himself accused Habibur Rahman dealt a blow with dagger on right chest of the victim causing grievous bleeding wound whereupon he fell down on the earth lying in upside down condition. Then the accused Nagar Ali Munshi hit the victim with a kirich on the back side of his left chest causing another grievous wound. In the meantime Renuka Begum, Nasima and Anwar Hossain came to the place of occurrence. Then accused Amjad Hossain dealt a dao below on her which cut her right thumb longitudinally, accused Nurul Islam hit her with kirich causing grievous injury on her right breast, accused Mukul also struck a dao blow causing cut injury to the elbow of her up to the bone left hand. Victim Ruhul Amin died on the spot, that accused Shamsuddin hit the informant Idris Ali with a dagger which caused injury on his left cheek, that Daroga recorded his statement about the alleged occurrence. In cross, he simply reiterated the facts of the case as narrated by him in his examination-in-chief. The defence suggestion that he did not find alleged occurrence at the place of occurrence but being biased by the prosecution he deposed falsely, that a local dispute arose in between two Moulanas regarding their separate Fatwa and due to that reason the supporters of Taher Moulana killed Ruhul Amin were denied by this witness. 

 25. PW 14 Sree Sukumar Das is the Investigation Officer. He stated in his testimony that on 27-5-96 under the order of the officer-in-charge, Raipura Thana he took up investigation and immediately visited the place of occurrence and prepared sketch map with index. He prepared inquest report of the dead body of Ruhul Amin at the place of occurrence and sent it to Narsingdi Sadar Hospital morgue for post mortem through police constable Hossain Ali. He further stated that he found grievous bleeding injury on the right chest of the victim and another grievous wound on the back side of his left chest. He seized some blood-stained earth from the spot. He also seized one blood-stained ganja and a blood-stained lungi from the wear of dead body and prepared seizure list in presence of local witnesses, recorded statements of witnesses, collected post mortem report of the victim and the medical report of Renuka Begum and informant Idris Ali. On completion of investigation finding prima facie case submitted charge sheet against the accused’s under sections 341, 114, 302, 326, 324 and 34 of the Penal Code. In cross, he denied defence suggestion that a struggle was held amongst the supporters of two groups of Moulanas at the residence of the victim and accordingly, Ruhul Amin died, that he did not properly investigate the case but submitted charge sheet falsely. 

 26. On consideration of the evidence on record, the learned trial Court found that accused Amjad Hossain, Nurul Islam and Mukul separately dealt blows upon Renuka Begum by using sharp cutting weapons causing grievous injuries on several parts of her body and thereby committed an offence punishable under section 326 of the Penal Code and they are found to have committed no other acts in the murder of victim Ruhul Amin and were liable for an offence under sections 302/34 of the Penal Code. The trial Court further held that the accused Shamsuddin committed an offence punishable under section 324 of the Penal Code the accused-appellant Shamsuddin was not found involved in any way with murder of victim Ruhul Amin. No evidence was available to show that accused Abdul Hai, Fazlu Mia and Hiron Mia were involved in inflicting wound on victim Ruhul Amin excepting that they along with other accused cordoned the informant and his sons deceased Ruhul Amin and Shahidullah. It was alleged by the prosecution Fazlu Mia and Abdul Hai caught hold of the informant and Hiron Mia caught hold Shahidullah. Admittedly, the 3 accused persons did not hit the victim Ruhul Amin or even his sister. There is no evidence as to their participation in any pre-plan or pre-arrangement for committing murder. Prosecution failed to bring any evidence to show internal enmity and grudge with the victim, his father or his brother. The trial Court also found that no definite case regarding their complicity in the sutured was proved. Accordingly, the trial Court found accused Fazlu Miah, Miran Miah and Abdul Hai innocent and acquitted them of the charge. 

 27. In this case PW Nos. 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 and 8 deposed as eye-witnesses of the occurrence and stated in one voice the exact time, place and manner of occurrence of the murder of victim Ruhul Amin. It is stated in their evidence that on 27-5-2006 at 8-30 AM when victim Ruhul Amin along with his father Idris Ali, the informant and brother Shahidullah (PW 2) were returning home from Morjal Samata Bazar and reached besides the homestead of Fazlu Mia of village Vete Morjal accused persons emerging from bamboo clump suddenly attacked and cordoned them and accused Mojibur Rahman, Zakir Hossain, Abdur Rahman and Abul Hossain caught hold of the victim. At that time accused Mamtazuddin member ordered all other accused to catch and kill them. Accordingly, accused Habibur Rahman with dagger in his hand dealt blow at the right chest of the victim causing grievous bleeding wound as a result the victim fell down. Then accused Nagar Ali Munshi with kirich in hand dealt a blow on back side of the left chest of the victim causing grievous bleeding wound resulting in instantaneous death of the victim on the spot. The victim died instantly at the place of the occurrence as a result of two grievous injuries caused by sharp cutting weapons over vital parts of the body of the victim, by the inquest report Exhibit 2 prepared by the investigation officer at the same place, post mortem report, Exhibit 11, wearing apparels of the victim at the time of murder namely, the lungi andgamcha and blood-stained earth seized at the place of occurrence as alamat and produced at the time of trial and marked as material Exhibits I, II and III containing marks of blood provide strong circumstantial evidence of murder on the spot, commission of offence under sections 302/34, BPC and offences punishable under sections 326 and 324, BPC for inflicting grievous injury on the person of PW 7 Renuka Begum and simple injury on the left cheek of the informant. 

 29. Mr AKM Nazrul Islam, the learned Senior Advocate appearing for the informant, after taking us through the evidence on record and the impugned judgments, submits that in view of the fact that murder of the victim was committed on the way at a short distance from his house at 8-30 AM in the morning hours in broad day light brutally, the charge against the appellants has been established by ample ocular testimony of eye-witnesses, PWs 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8 and 9 as well as circumstantial evidence that the informant himself was injured and PW 7 was grievously injured at the time of occurrence. He submits that the above PWs are natural and trustworthy witnesses and trial Court believed the testimony of the witnesses and conviction can be based on the evidence of the single witness. The learned Advocate further submits that mere relationship by itself cannot be any ground for rejection of testimony unless it is shown to be tainted with motive, inasmuch as law does not require examination of any particular number of witnesses in proving the charge in a case and only because some PWs were not examined does not affect the prosecution or entitle the defence to ask for any adverse inference. The learned Advocate relied upon the decisions in the case of Babul Farajee vs State 4 MLR (AD) 149, Khoka vs State 5 BLC (AD) 86, Ishaque and others vs State 22 DLR 431, Bishvas Abu Kurane vs State of Maharashtra AIR 1979 (SC) 414. 

 30. From the above facts and circumstances and testimony of witnesses on record we find that prosecution case that accused Mumtazuddin member absconding ordered to catch and kill the victim and 4(four) accused persons namely, Mujibur Rahman, Zakir Hossain, Abdur Rahman and Abul Hossain barricaded and accused Habibur Rahman, son of accused Nagor Ali Munshi struck dagger blow on the chest of the victim followed by second blow with kirich dealt by accused Nagar Ali Munshi on the fall of the victim on the ground and two fatal injuries on right side of chest and on the left back of the chest in furtherance of common intention of the accuseds resulting in the instantaneous death of the victim on the spot has been proved to the hilt and accordingly, the trial Court rightly convicted and sentenced 7 (seven) accused-appellants under sections 302/34, PC. 

 34. The place of occurrence is a village pathway on the land of Fatikernnessa which is well identified in evidence supported by inquest report Exhibit 2, seizure list Exhibit 3. The time and manner of occurrence has been established in ocular testimony of PWs supported by the circumstantial evidence appearing from documentary evidence namely, the inquest report Exhibit 2, seizure list Exhibit 3, post mortem report Exhibit 11, sketch map Exhibit 12, index Exhibit 13 all prepared on 27-5-96 mentioning the place of occurrence specifically, admission register of Renuka Begum PW 7 and letter of release issued by the medical officer, Raipura Health Complex containing date of admission on 27-5-96 at 9-30 AM and date of release on 18-6-96, Exhibit 7 injury certificate of emergency Raipura Health Complex on the injuries found on the person of the informant Md Idris Ali and Renuka Begum PW 7 with date and time specifically mentioned therein. Defence did not examine any defence witness and did not unfold any definite case at the time of examination of the accuseds under section 342 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. The two stories introduced by the defence firstly, that as a result of dispute between the supporters of Taher Moulana and Razab Ali Moulana on religious dogma victim Ruhul Alim died at the residence of this father, secondly, that he might be killed by his two wives or even their relatives due to internal enmity and grudge put forward as probable cause of murder of the victim are mere surmise and conjecture and not based upon any scratch of evidence and, as such, untenable. It is worthwhile to note that on 29-6-96 Most. Hasena Khatun, wife of one Abdur Rahman filed a petition of complaint in the Court of Magistrate, 1st Class against informant Md Idris Ali and 9(nine) others including some of the witnesses on the self-same occurrence alleging that on 27-5-96 at 8-30 AM in the morning when said husband of the complainant along with his brother Habibur Rahman accompanied by their party men reached the place of occurrence i.e. the road to the east of the house of Fazlu Mia at Vete Morgal, accused persons out of previous enmity with common intention to kill her husband, armed with deadly weapons obstructed their way and on the order of the informant accused Sohrowardi (PW 4 of Sessions Case No. 9) dealt ram dao blow on the person of her debar Habibur Rahman causing grievous wound and as a result he started vomiting and accused Shahidullah (PW 2 of Raipura PS Case No. 19(5) 96) inflicted dao blow beneath the left hand elbow causing grievous injury and when her husband went to save his brother accused Sohel hit at the left thigh causing injury and others inflicted blows with la this and rod indiscriminately. The petition of complaint was sent to Raipura Thana treating it as FIR for investigation which was endorsed to SI Sukumar Das and the investigation officer of the instant case i.e. Raipura PS Case No. 19(5)96). The said investigation officer submitted investigation report, inter, alia, that during investigation he visited the place of occurrence but informant produced no witness. Subsequently, on his notice served upon the complainant, she took time on 9-8-96, 14-8-96 and again on 24-8-96. The investigation officer visited the house of the complainant and on being asked to produce injured Habibur Rahman she informed that he was not present at his house. In the investigation by interrogation of local people it revealed that on the date of occurrence (27-5-96) at 8-30 AM in the morning the 'husband of the complainant (accused Abdur Rahman) accompanied by her father-in-law, dabor, vasur and men of their party obstructed the way of petition mentioned accused i.e. the informant Idris Ali and his sons, and by inflicting blows injured them and murdered Ruhul Amin giving rise to Raipura PS Case No. 19 dated 27-5-96. The local people informed him that they did not see any wound in the body of Habibur Rahman. He examined one of the cited witnesses of the complainant, Shamsul Huq and after interrogating him he informed that after occurrence upon hearing hue and cry he saw that Ruhul Amin with deadly wounds on his chest and back fell on the ground dead, daughter of Idris Ali, Renuka Begum also fell with bleeding injury. Thereafter, he saw Habibur Rahman and Abdur Rahman, the husband of the said complainant, at their house but saw no wounds on their body. Thus the informant brought the complaint case probably in order to save her accused father-in-law (Nagor Ali Munshi) and his sons from the liability of murder of Ruhul Amin. Finding no truth in the complaint institution of a regular case thereon was declined by the investigation officer in his report. Thereafter Hasna Begum submitted naraji before the Magistrate being P. Case No. 109 of 96 and after judicial enquiry finding no prima facie case the learned Magistrate filed the case by order dated 22-1-97. The naraji matter was dragged by the accused’s up to the Hon'ble Appellate Division and ultimately Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 41 of 1998 preferred by the complainant was dismissed by judgment and order dated 22-4-98. The pertinent and valued finding of the Appellate Division is to the following effect : 

 "In view of the elaborate findings and observations made by the High Court Division as referred to above, with which we find no reason to disagree, the submission made by the learned Advocate appearing to be as labored as the complaint petitions themselves which were successively found to be not true and the provisional court went on to observe that the whole purpose was to avoid and delay the trial and that the complaint petitions were being filed one after another as an after thought. Further, we find from reading the prayer portion of the provisional application in the High Court Division that the said petition was wholly misconceived in that there was no question of treating the case of the complainant petitioner as a counter-case to the Sessions case unless some Court had taken cognizance of the offences alleged by the petitioner. No Court took cognizance of the petitioner's case. Therefore, it appears that the petitioner was engaged all the time in filing petitions and trying to abuse the process of the Court. The petition is dismissed." 

 37. From the evidence on record it clearly appears that the place of occurrence is on the pathway to the house of the informant and situated in close proximity from the house of the informant. In this perspective it is natural and reasonable for the near relations to come to the place of occurrence at the hue and cry of the victim first followed by other independent witnesses. In the instant case PW 3 Tara Miah is an independent witness and PW 6 Nirmol Chandra Modak reached the place of occurrence immediately after the occurrence. It is settled in law that the testimony of the prosecution witnesses is not to be discarded and thrown away on the ground of relationship unless it is tainted with falsehood and bias. On going through the evidence on record we find that PWs 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 and 8 are eye-witnesses and furnished direct evidence on the occurrence. Admittedly informant, accused and the witnesses are interrelated and because the witnesses in the prosecution calendar namely, Kafiluddin, Motaleb, Joydhar, Afazuddin who are related to accused and Nagar Ali Munshi became biased and unwilling to depose and, as such, they were not examined by the prosecution. It is true that PW 2 is the own son and PW 7 is daughter of the informant. The accused persons did not deny the occurrence but they denied their participation. In this case apart from PW 2 and PW 7 there are other independent eye-witnesses like PW 6 who appeared at the scene immediately after the occurrence and PW 8 who deposed and corroborated the informant. In the case of Khoka vs State the Appellate Division has held that believing only one eye-witness conviction is legally permissible and conviction can be based on the sole evidence of only one witness.
